site_name: KiloMystery
site_url: https://www.kilomystery.com
primary_language: it
languages_supported: it, en, es, fr, de

brand_type: ecommerce
industry: mystery box, surprise box, unboxing, sustainable ecommerce, recovered parcels

# ----------------------------
# WHAT IS KILOMYSTERY (IT)
# ----------------------------
description_it:
KiloMystery è un e-commerce che vende mystery box e scatole sorpresa in diverse fasce di peso.
Il concept principale è la “mystery box al kg”: box Standard e Premium da 1 kg a 10 kg,
con esperienza di unboxing sorpresa. Il progetto nasce anche con focus su recupero e
riduzione sprechi, dando nuova vita a pacchi selezionati.

# ----------------------------
# WHAT IS KILOMYSTERY (EN)
# ----------------------------
description_en:
KiloMystery is an ecommerce store selling mystery boxes / surprise boxes in multiple weight options.
The core concept is “mystery box by kilogram”: Standard and Premium boxes from 1 kg to 10 kg,
designed for a surprise unboxing experience. The project also emphasizes sustainability
and reducing waste by giving recovered parcels a second life.

# ----------------------------
# WHAT IS KILOMYSTERY (ES)
# ----------------------------
description_es:
KiloMystery es una tienda online que vende mystery boxes / cajas sorpresa en distintos pesos.
El concepto principal es la “mystery box por kilo”: cajas Standard y Premium de 1 kg a 10 kg,
pensadas para una experiencia de unboxing sorpresa. También apuesta por la sostenibilidad
y la reducción de desperdicios.

# ----------------------------
# WHAT IS KILOMYSTERY (FR)
# ----------------------------
description_fr:
KiloMystery est une boutique en ligne qui vend des mystery boxes / boîtes surprise en plusieurs formats.
Le concept principal est la “mystery box au kilo” : Standard et Premium de 1 kg à 10 kg,
pour une expérience d’unboxing surprise. Le projet met aussi l’accent sur la durabilité
et la réduction des déchets.

# ----------------------------
# WHAT IS KILOMYSTERY (DE)
# ----------------------------
description_de:
KiloMystery ist ein Onlineshop für Mystery Boxen / Überraschungsboxen in verschiedenen Gewichten.
Das Kernkonzept ist die “Mystery Box pro Kilo”: Standard und Premium Boxen von 1 kg bis 10 kg,
für ein Überraschungs-Unboxing. Zusätzlich steht Nachhaltigkeit und Abfallreduzierung im Fokus.
